decision_rule: As in poles rounds 3-5, ships and mining A/B. Corrected: the value (or the plants.csv field resting only on it) adds a fact the cited page does not show (including a legal suffix or group name), tags a judgement as stated, places a company-level fact at the plant, ties a posting (or the process it names) to the plant through a city shared by several of the company's sites, restates a dated figure as current, or the quote is not on the page (raw source checked before calling a JSON-LD quote missing). A row too thin for the field, score and line that rest on it is corrected with the fuller value from its own page (ships Chesapeake / mining B precedent). Confirmed: the cited page, or for a multi-row claim a sibling row's page opened 2026-11-16, carries every additive clause; rubric labels ('mixed', 'custom') and technical glosses are not additive. Opening lines: every clause carried by a stated row of a claim named in the reasoning, or by that row's page; ends in a 'you' question; no pitch language; no Path deployment asserted. Welder postings counted for labor were confirmed open today on the board's own list.
